sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Pressing pain in temples from without in-
wards: zvorse, left side. Viscid salivation; constant in-
clination to spit. Sick headache coming on when devi-
ating from ordinary pursuits. Headaches from nerve
tire caused by mental or physical exhaustion, preceded
by hunger.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
IVorse, from working in open air.
Better, from sleep.
